title: The three-dimensional structure of the Eta Carinae Homunculus

evidence.locator: Abstract: a 3D model from VLT/X-shooter H2 2.12125 micron spectra, with circumpolar trenches and off-planar equatorial protrusions; a hole near the centre of each polar lobe; no detectable H2 from the thin optical skirt; "we also include a 3D printable version of our Homunculus model". Sect. 2: the whole nebula (14 x 20 arcsec) mapped on 9 and 10 March 2012. Sect. 3: optical images are continuum light scattered by dust, a relatively thin, clumpy surface; a single continuous surface of each lobe is reconstructed. Sect. 4.1: radial speed 680 km/s (r / 3.4e15 m)^1.2 in the blue (south-east, approaching) lobe and 600 km/s (r / 3.4e15 m) in the red (north-west, receding) lobe.
